tool_definitions.name: file_system__compress_directory

access_token.description: Access token obtained from file_system app login.

compressed_file_path.description: Path of the compressed file. Path can be absolute, starting with '/', or relative to the user's home directory, starting with '~/'. If passed, must have an extension: zip or tar. If not passed, it'll be stored as a zip file with the base name of directory_path in directory_path's parent directory.

delete_directory.description: Whether to delete the directory after compression.

directory_path.description: Path of the directory to compress. Path can be absolute, starting with '/', or relative to the user's home directory, starting with '~/'.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the compressed file if it already exists.

tool_definitions.description: Decompress a compressed file.
tool_definitions.name: file_system__decompress_file

access_token.description: Access token obtained from file_system app login.

compressed_file_path.description: Path of the compressed file. Path can be absolute, starting with '/', or relative to the user's home directory, starting with '~/'. Must have an extension: zip or tar.

decompressed_directory_path.description: Path of the directory to save decompressed files. Path can be absolute, starting with '/', or relative to the user's home directory, starting with '~/'. If not passed, it'll be saved in the same directory as the compressed file.

delete_compressed_file.description: Whether to delete the compressed file after decompression.

retain_dates.description: Whether the decompressed files should retain the created and updated dates of the files in the compressed file.

workflow_definition.aggregation_logic: Specialist artifacts are relayed upward as reports; the orchestrator merges those reports into one artifact.
conditional_edges: dispatch_specialists -> specialist_worker (parallel Send fan-out) else relay_specialist_reports
workflow_definition.dispatch_logic: The orchestrator emits bounded task packages to the activated specialists.
stopping_criteria: Semantic no-progress across orchestrator merge artifacts
